description: Backend + content foundation. Add Flyway V9 (Java migration with its own JSON bank) that adds the DIABETES topic, TOPIC_SELECTED analytics event, retitles the NHS source (removes a drug name from UI), reassigns/retires legacy questions and seeds 19 new source-verified, Indian-context questions so every topic has >=6 active questions. Make QuizService.start() guarantee on-topic questions and top up from related topics only when a topic has <3. Extend AnalyticsService (topic, ctaContext). Frontend work depends on the JSON this feature creates. Independent of nothing else; must be done first.

Selection: on-topic first (random), then related in order, then any published; GENERAL = one per concern; 404 only if full pool <3.

SOURCE VERIFICATION (web_fetch this run): VERIFIED by reading page: NIDDK prescription medications page (individual choice, factors, never in pregnancy/planning, not recommended when breastfeeding, probably regain some weight after stopping, 2 days/week muscle-strengthening, buy from approved pharmacy); WHO GLP-1 Q&A (not for everyone, prescribed after individual history, common GI effects mild and decrease over time, originally for type 2 diabetes now also obesity, not a replacement for diet/activity); NICE recommendations page (lower BMI thresholds for South Asian backgrounds; weight-related conditions: high BP, dyslipidaemia, sleep apnoea, CVD, type 2 diabetes); Guy's food-and-nutrition (protein for muscle, eggs/lentils/beans/dairy, strength 2x/week) and managing-side-effects (small frequent meals, avoid fatty foods, fluids/fibre/lentils for constipation, when to contact team); NHS GLP-1 page (diabetes or obesity use, fake-medicine websites, tell doctor about other medicines/insulin, do not stop suddenly, pregnancy/breastfeeding); CDC adults overview verified via CDC's own content mirror https://tools.cdc.gov/api/v2/resources/media/132340/content.html because www.cdc.gov returns 403 to the fetch tool (2 days/week muscle-strengthening confirmed; URL already exists in DB from V4). Research items (pubmed 35441470, 19582986, 41877354, 39372917): pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov blocks the fetch tool (returns a bot-wall page), so record/abstract content was verified through the Europe PMC REST record for each PMID (titles, authors, journals, abstracts matched: STEP 1 extension participants regained about two-thirds of prior loss a year after withdrawal; Misra 2009 Asian Indian consensus: abdominal adiposity, narrower/lower normal BMI limits, ectopic fat; lean-mass meta-analysis 2026: lean-mass share broadly comparable between incretin therapy and lifestyle, resistance training/protein/body-composition monitoring preserve muscle; Tinsley & Heymsfield 2024: fat-free mass vs fat mass distinctions, resistance exercise and protein as countermeasures).

DEVIATIONS: (1) ICMR-NIN Dietary Guidelines 2024 DROPPED: nin.res.in does not resolve from this environment (DNS failure), so it could not be verified; protein-food claims rely on Guy's instead and Indian foods (dal, curd, sprouts, egg, paneer) appear only as examples inside options/explanations, not as sourced claims. (2) The NICE discussion-aid PDF could not be fetched (PDF unsupported by the tool), so the NICE recommendations page is the only NICE source. (3) No WHO claim about 'tests first' was found, so Q38 is sourced to NIDDK (factors a professional weighs: health issues, other medicines, family history) and NICE (comorbidities). (4) Q36 and Q32 both use the Misra consensus (belly fat/lower BMI); 'looks slim' wording is in Q36 only. (5) Correct-answer index across Q22-40: [1,2,1,0,0,2,1,1,1,0,1,1,2,0,1,1,0,1,2]; 2 or 3 options per question.

CHECKS: banned-string + no-numeric scan (context regex plus 'lose \d+', '\d+%', guarantee patterns) over text/options/explanation/titles/organizations of the v9 JSON returned no hits; every explanation <=45 words and MYTH_OR_FACT explanations start 'Myth.'/'Fact.'; reviewedBy null; all questions have >=1 sourceKey that exists in sources.
